name: Elysia Client — Windows (x64)
note: Recommended. Client version 8.6. Run Start-Elysia.bat — it starts the connection bridge and then the client. Use "Another" in the server list to type a different address.

name: Elysia Client — Linux (x86-64)
note: Unpack and run ./run.sh — it checks the system libraries and starts the connection bridge. Requires glibc 2.38 or newer.
